hook: Four astronauts were sitting on top of this fire.
narration: Four astronauts were sitting on top of this fire, on their way around the Moon.
This is Artemis II on April 1, filmed in slow motion from across the water at Kennedy Space Center.
At six thirty-five p.m., the engines lit and the rocket began to rise off Launch Complex 39B.
Most of the push at liftoff comes from the two solid rocket boosters, and once they light, they cannot be shut off.
Inside Orion were Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen.
It was the first crewed mission of NASA's Artemis campaign.
outcome: Artemis II cleared the tower and climbed away with its four astronauts, bound for the Moon.
title: Artemis II from across the water
description:
On April 1, 2026, NASA's SLS rocket launched four astronauts in the Orion spacecraft on the Artemis II test flight from Launch Complex 39B at Kennedy Space Center, Florida, seen here in slow motion from the causeway.
